per_scenario_verdicts.evidence: Uses configurable statuses, priorities, and disabled claims; places decided last among non-archived statuses and avoids a film-specific mode or binary.
Accepts literal shared search with concise match provenance and preserved ID lookup; explicitly leaves the reported TUI limitation unverified.
Preserves separate scheduled occurrences and missed work through an explicit idempotent opening command, with holiday skips and a bounded future horizon.
Keeps source directories authoritative, qualifies task IDs by board, limits the view to reads, and reports unavailable boards separately while respecting their configurations.
Recognizes current metadata loss, preserves nested values without museum-specific fields, and requires legacy protection or migration before lossy writes; separates comments from value fidelity.
Proposes a one-way calendar file with stable event identity, all-day dates, explicit completion treatment, and an allowlist excluding private bodies and contact details.
Starts with existing narrow-layout and title controls, verifies remaining phone navigation gaps, and checks comfortable rendering on a wide monitor.
Preserves missing-is-satisfied behavior on unchanged boards while proposing opt-in strict policy shared by eligibility listing and pick, with distinct missing-ID diagnostics.
Places process, worktree, spending, and stall supervision in a separate runner; retains agent choice and human stops without promising safe concurrent dispatch from existing claims.
Requires reviewable identity mappings, preservation of both bodies and ambiguous references, suggested prose changes, and stale-claim resolution; rejects disconnected coordination guarantees.
per_scenario_verdicts.diagnostic_omission: Mentions existing duplicate repair and proposes provenance and backups, but does not explicitly require evidence capture before a load path can automatically repair IDs. This does not defeat a critical check.

per_scenario_verdicts.evidence: Offers a repeatable Markdown or printable HTML snapshot using configured statuses and no bodies; defines generation and reporting dates and requires reliable completion history.
Defers unresolved hierarchy and archived-child policy while allowing per-parent automation; protects independent parent decisions through transition provenance and bounded reopening.
Limits synchronization to an optional linked-task adapter with field ownership, preview/apply, three-way conflicts, private-note exclusion, and offline local use.
per_scenario_verdicts.diagnostic_omission: Acknowledges available authentication and makes publication an explicit apply operation, but does not expressly state that authentication is not authorization to publish. No publication or other side effect is requested.

per_scenario_verdicts.evidence: Proposes bounded opt-in presence checks across all mutation paths, preserving prior state and readable legacy records; addresses tags, explicit exceptions, and deliberate file-edit bypass.
Recognizes stored arbitrary sequence, compares parent-owned ordering with child rank and metadata costs, and rejects implicit changes to pick while addressing reparenting and deterministic recovery.
Reuses due-date comparison in a bounded child-view option, with undated tasks last and ID ties; adds neither persisted rank nor plugin/expression machinery.
Accepts default data protection on the stipulated focused reproduction without a setting or extra use-case gate; limits guarantees and requests proportionate failure-path verification.
Defers a weights field pending a concrete example and intended operation, distinguishing effort, selection priority, and progress contribution before deciding storage or reuse.
